title: PosMerchantRepeatingSchedule

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub or third-party provided external ID for the merchant.

name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

version_id.description: The ID of the version of this schedule which changes upon updates to the schedule.

description: The repeating weekly schedule of a merchant.

external_id.description: The merchant-set ID for this schedule, which can be used to link it in the `PosNormalizedMenu`.

name.description: The display name for this schedule, e.g. "Sunday Brunch"

type.description: How often this schedule repeats. Currently the only valid value is "WEEKLY".

rules.description: A set of non-overlapping time periods.

RepeatingSchedule.description: Information about a weekly schedule during which a menu item may be made available. Typical usages include Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Weekend Brunch, etc.

updated_by.description: The last credential to update the schedule

created_date.description: The creation date of the schedule

updated_date.description: The last update date of the schedule

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID of the schedule in MySQL

source.description: The source of the creation or update of the repeating schedule

RepeatingScheduleMetadata.description: The metadata associated to a specific repeating schedule

days.description: Days of the week for which the time period applies. Must be one of [MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY]

items.description: Days of the week for which the time period applies. Must be one of [MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY]

start_time.description: The time when this schedule begins on the days listed, in the merchant's local time. Must conform to ISO date and time format

end_time.description: The time when this schedule ends on the days listed, in the merchant's local time. Must conform to ISO date and time format

RepeatingScheduleRule.description: A time period and repetition rule.
